blurb: Spirit of the Wilderness outfits and guides canoe trips in the BWCA and Quetico, providing canoes, camping equipment, food packages, maps, and route planning. They offer complete and partial outfitting, guided trips, and transportation services. Lodging is available at their Ely facility with shared rooms and amenities.
